Austin has the highest professional services share of the big Texas cities, at over 23% of workers, and a median household income of about $90,000. Tech workers are used to instant replies and comfortable with AI, but they notice a poor one quickly. Rapid growth keeps home services busy, while restaurants and venues face surges during major events. Local AI receptionist competition exists, so voice quality matters most here.
